summary: The Veloce Ibrida Plug-In Q4 is the only plug-in grade in Alfa Romeo Australia's Tonale range — the other two cars sold here, the $64,990 Veloce Ibrida and the $68,990 Ibrida Sport Speciale, are 1.5-litre mild hybrids with no plug at all. The facelifted range landed here in July 2026 with the plug-in unchanged mechanically: a 1.3-litre turbo driving the front wheels, a 94kW motor driving the rears for a genuine electric all-wheel-drive layout, 198kW combined and 59km of WLTP electric range from a 15.5kWh (gross) pack. Australian testers like the way it steers and are impressed by what regular charging does to the fuel bill — CarsGuide's long-termer covered 673 of 934km on electricity for 2.6L/100km — but they are equally consistent that a flat battery turns it into a 1,811kg SUV pulling 6.1-7.0L/100km with, in OnlineAuto's words, performance that 'falls off a cliff'. The harder problem is the $14,000 it asks over the mild hybrid, on a car Australia bought 132 of in all of 2025.
pros: The only Tonale with a plug and the only one with all-wheel drive: a 94kW rear axle motor gives it e-AWD with no propshaft, 198kW combined and 0-100km/h in 6.6 seconds, where the $64,990 Veloce Ibrida mild hybrid is a 128kW front-driver.

Australian real-world testing shows the plug-in maths genuinely works for a charger-owning commuter — CarsGuide's long-term car averaged 2.6L/100km over 934km while charging two or three times a week, running 673 of those kilometres on electricity, and OnlineAuto recorded 1.8L/100km on a charged 60km loop.

Five-year, unlimited-kilometre warranty with no dealer-servicing condition attached — Alfa Romeo Australia's standard term since April 2022, not an offer conditional on servicing inside the network — plus a separate eight-year/160,000km high-voltage battery warranty and five years of roadside assistance.

Capped-price servicing is remarkably cheap for a premium European SUV: the first three services are quoted at $244.84, $231.92 and $244.84 at 12-month/15,000km intervals, in the same range as Alfa's Junior rather than a German rival.

At $78,990 before on-road costs it sits under the $80,809 ordinary luxury car tax threshold — and its 1.7L/100km label figure puts it under the $91,661 fuel-efficient threshold with room to spare — so no LCT applies, and 39g/km CO2 gets Victoria's green-vehicle stamp duty rate rather than the standard scale.
cons: It is $3,990 over the $75,000 cap that applies from 1 April 2027 — and academic in any case, because plug-in hybrids lost the FBT exemption outright on 1 April 2025, so a novated lease gets no exemption and no 25 per cent discount on this car at any point.

59km of WLTP electric range is the weakest number in the segment: a Cupra Formentor VZe claims 114km from 20kWh and a Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV 86km, and the Tonale's 15.5kWh gross pack only charges at 7.4kW AC with no DC capability at all, so there is no useful top-up on the road.

Once the battery is flat the 1.7L/100km label figure is meaningless — Australian testers measured 7.0L/100km and 6.1L/100km over two months of irregular charging and 6.2L/100km on a flat-battery loop, and OnlineAuto reports performance that 'falls off a cliff', so a buyer without home charging is paying a $14,000 premium over the mild hybrid to go slower and use more fuel.

The battery costs 125 litres of boot — 385 litres against 500 in the mild-hybrid Tonale, and 1,430 against 1,550 with the second row folded — and braked towing is only 1,250kg, below the Cupra Formentor VZe's 1,500kg and well below the BMW X1 xDrive25e's 1,700kg.

Resale risk is the worst in this comparison set and it is evidenced, not assumed: Alfa Romeo sold 132 Tonales in Australia across all of 2025 and 33 in 2026 to date, supports them through eight dealers it has said it will not expand, and a 2024 Tonale has already shed 54 per cent of its value in two years — 75th-100th percentile depreciation among 2024 SUVs. Italian metalworker unions report Tonale production ending in November 2027 as Pomigliano is retooled, which would leave this an orphan model within two years of purchase.
